cost_estimate: per Birth attempt 1 union enumeration (0.015-0.03 s on saturated explicit states, 0.17-0.18 s near the seed) plus the V001 transform; per legal transform 1 more union enumeration. V003 measured 1765 s for 3072 sweeps; V004 runs 4096 sweeps and turns about 80% of Birth attempts from cheap self loops into transforms. Explicit-state estimate, not a measurement of the pilot; expected well inside the 8800 s soft wall.
interpretation_limits: No physical rate, new Hamiltonian term, altered worldline measure or modified owned labels.
No claim that census/U slowness causes the residual R/S failure (UNTESTED per the review); the deciding tests decide.
On saturated explicit native states only reverse Birth marks exist (C1); the move lowers the census there and births re-raise it.
No ergodicity or mixing claim; accepted-move counts alone are insufficient.
Fresh seed: an independent bounded pilot, not a paired comparison with OWNED_L4_WORM_LOOP_RUN_V001.
